name: stock_traceability
summary: Lot recall/quarantine workflows, expiry monitoring and a movement-derived traceability chain
description: Builds on the Inventory anchor's lot and serial registries: a traceability event chain derived from posted operations, recall and quarantine workflows that block lots from reservation and issue, an expiry-monitor cron with idempotent alerts, and FEFO-aware disposition handling (blueprint section 8).
author: Nexa
